values.note: Booking opens 11 months ahead and same-day booking is allowed. Check-in 3 pm, check-out 1 pm. The campground is for permitted campers only; the entrance gate needs a combination 24 hours a day (given with the reservation). Reserve online or at 1-877-879-3859.

note: Former mine-site campground in Withlacoochee State Forest's Citrus Tract; sites in a horseshoe beside a rain-filled former mine-pit lake. Follow the Forest Service's directions only (Pleasant Grove Rd / C-581 to Forest Road, Trail 16): it warns not to trust GPS, and trailers and two-wheel-drive vehicles must use that route. Call WSF dispatch (352-797-4100) the day of arrival to check for prescribed burns. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on FDACS and the FLFS ReserveAmerica page: 13 back-in RV-or-tent sites to 40 ft with water at the site, restroom but no showers, open year round, reservable 11 months ahead incl. same day, gate combination. Fees left (human-checked 2026-10-12). Not stated: electric (none listed, but no explicit 'no'), dump, max stay, fcfs.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: FDACS says 'campsites in a horseshoe formation next to a picturesque, rain-filled lake that was formerly a mine pit', and ReserveAmerica's site details give 'Type of View: Lake'; the entry is 'not waterfront' and its note said 'not directly on water'.
Phone missing: the booking line is 1-877-879-3859 (ReserveAmerica); the Withlacoochee State Forest visitor center is (352) 797-4140.
